title: The Bone Chilling Flame and Dragon Island
summary: Granny Hua's sealed Dou Qi is crashing through Yun Yun's meridians and could kill her, so Xiao Yan soothes it with the Bone Chilling Flame and gives her a Fiery Pill to help refine it. With the flame's resistance gone, he goes into seclusion in the Flower Sect and fuses the Bone Chilling Flame with his own. The Flame Mantra does not reach Tian Class, but he reaches Four-Star Dou Zun. On his way home Hei Qing finds him through a dragon seal Zi Yan left on him and takes him to Dragon Island. Elder Zhu Li explains that Zi Yan's father is the missing Dragon Emperor and that the clan has split into four warring islands. Zi Yan is sealed in a crystal of Dragon-Phoenix energy, and only a top-ten Heavenly Flame can melt it. Meanwhile three dragon islands gather to attack East Dragon Island.
events: Xiao Yan calms Granny Hua's Dou Qi inside Yun Yun with the Bone Chilling Flame.
He gives Yun Yun a Fiery Pill.
He goes into seclusion and fuses the Bone Chilling Flame.
Thunderclouds form, and he reaches Four-Star Dou Zun.
Xiao Yan leaves the Flower Sect, and Hei Qing finds him.
On Dragon Island, Zhu Li explains Zi Yan's royal blood and the clan's split.
Xiao Yan sees Zi Yan sealed in crystal and agrees to help.
Man Yan, Xia Ao and Qing Yan plan a joint attack on East Dragon Island.
cultivation: Xiao Yan reaches Four-Star Dou Zun after fusing the Bone Chilling Flame. The Flame Mantra does not evolve to Tian Class.

cast.name: Xiao Yan
cast.quote: But I've reached Four-Star Dou Zun.
